prompt:
Create one photorealistic editorial image for an Egyptian legal-awareness post. Depict the exact concrete action, object, document type, evidence, and setting in the visual brief; do not substitute a generic lawyer portrait, courthouse, scales, gavel, handshake, or stock office. Set the scene unmistakably in present-day Egypt in the 2020s: modern Cairo/Giza streets, contemporary apartments, ordinary current offices, current-model smartphones, laptops, cars, furniture, clothing, and materials. ABSOLUTE STYLE BAN: this is NOT ancient Egypt, NOT Pharaonic, NOT archaeological, NOT historical, NOT a period drama, and NOT a fantasy scene. Never show pyramids, sphinxes, obelisks, hieroglyphics, ancient temples, tombs, sarcophagi, mummies, pharaohs, royal crowns, ancient columns, papyrus, sandstone monuments, gold masks, ancient Egyptian motifs, or ornamental Pharaonic patterns. A minimalist office plant sits in the left corner, and a sleek coffee mug with steam adds a touch of everyday realism.
